HERO_DESCRIPTION: Drag the sliders to match your site. The price updates as you go, and we save where you left off. No sign-up, no card.
PRESETS_LABEL: Start from a site like yours
LABEL_MONTHLY_TRAFFIC_HELP: Every load of a page that has a FastComments widget on it, not just the pages people comment on.
LABEL_COMMENTS_STORED_HELP: The total you keep with us, not the number posted each month. Migrating an archive? Count it here.
LABEL_TEAM_SEATS_HELP: People who log in to manage billing, settings and developer access. The first seat is free.
LABEL_COMMUNITY_MEMBERS_HELP: Members you sign in through your own login system. Leave this at 0 if you are not using SSO.
LABEL_DOMAINS_HELP: Count development sites other than localhost. The first domain is free.
LABEL_MODERATORS_HELP: People who review and action comments but do not need account or billing access.
LABEL_MANAGED_TENANTS_HELP: Separate sub-accounts under yours, one per client, site or environment. We call these tenants.
LABEL_API_CREDITS_HELP: In most cases 1 credit is 1 API call. Leave this at 0 if you are not calling our API.
HEADING_ADVANCED_HINT: Domains, moderators, tenants and API usage
EDIT_VALUE_HINT: Click to type an exact number
BREAKDOWN_EMPTY: Nothing billable yet. Move a slider to see the breakdown.
MESSAGE_EXCEEDS_LIMITS: This plan doesn't support your requirements
ERROR_QUOTE_FAILED: We couldn't update the estimate. Reload the page, or contact us and we'll price it with you.
